#!/bin/sh

### mudskipper: resorted bam file based on name
for name in ./data_dir/*.bam;
do

name_2="$(echo "$name" | cut -d '/' -f 3 | cut -d '.' -f 1)"
echo "$name_2"

./mudskipper-main/target/release/mudskipper shuffle
--bam ${name}
-o ./resorted_dir/${name_2}.resorted.bam

done

###
#transform genome based bam file (resorted based on name using mudskipper) which generated by STAR alignment to transcriptomic based bam file

for name in ./resorted_dir/*sorted.bam;
do

name_2="$(echo "$name" | cut -d '/' -f 3 | cut -d '.' -f 1)"
echo "$name_2"

./mudskipper-main/target/release/mudskipper bulk \
--gtf ./reference_dir/Bombus_terrestris.Bter_1.0.55.gtf \
--alignment ./resorted_dir/*sorted.bam \
--out ./transcriptome_bam_dir/${name_2}.transcriptomic.bam \
--threads 10 \
-p

done

### transcriptome_combine
# Bombue terrestris transcriptome (Bter_1.0, Ensembl Metazoa) is separated in two parts: cdna and ncrna.
# we should combine them in one file and sort it with genomic order.

grep -v '#' ./reference_dir/Bombus_terrestris.Bter_1.0.55.gtf | awk '$3=="transcript"' | cut -f 1,4,5,9 | sed 's/\tgene_id/ gene_id/g' | sed 's/";//g' | sed 's/"/:/g' | awk -F '[ ]' '{print $1,$4,$5,$2,$3,$6.$7,$8,$9,$10,$11,$12,$13}' | sed 's/ transcript_id :/\t/g' | sed 's/ :/:/g' > transcript.bed

bedtools getfasta 
-fi Bombus_terrestris.Bter_1.0.dna.toplevel.fa 
-bed transcript.bed 
-fo total_transcriptome.fa 
-name 
-split


### reheader bam file based on genome
grep -v '#' ./reference_dir/Bombus_terrestris.Bter_1.0.55.gtf | awk '$3=="transcript"' | cut -f 4,5,9 | cut -d ";" -f 1,2 | awk '{print $6,$1,$2}' | awk '$4=$3-$2' | sed 's/ /\t/g' | sed 's/"//g' | cut -f 1,4 > new_header.txt

awk '$3="@SQ"' new_header.txt | awk '$4="SN:"' | awk '$5="LN:"' | awk '{print $3,$4,$1,$5,$2 }' | sed 's/SN: /SN:/g' | sed 's/LN: /LN:/g' | sed 's/ /\t/g' > new_header.tmp

for name in ./transcriptome_bam_dir/*.transcriptomic.bam;
do

name_2="$(echo "$name" | cut -d '/' -f 3 | cut -d '.' -f 1)"
echo "$name_2"

samtools reheader new_header.sam ${name} > ./reheader_dir/${name_2}.reheader.bam

done
